svg.aria-label: A developer portal roadmap in three phases. Phase 1, foundation (months 0 to 3): asset discovery, CloudQuery setup and governance, ending with a complete inventory. Phase 2, deployment (months 3 to 12): Backstage deployment, the service catalog and plugins, developer onboarding, then automation and compliance, ending with the portal live. Phase 3, maturity (12 months and on): advanced analytics and AI optimization, reaching platform maturity around month 18.
